candidate_or_spec: Raspberry Pi CM5, CM5104032 (Wi-Fi, 4 GB RAM, 32 GB eMMC)
selection_and_verification: Verify exact CM5104032 operating range, carrier thermal performance, worst-case update deadline and storage endurance.

candidate_or_spec: Compact CM5 carrier with Gigabit Ethernet, USB/UART and suitable RF antenna connection
selection_and_verification: Use a CM5 IO Board during bench debugging. Use CAD and temperature limits to select a compact installed carrier.

candidate_or_spec: One ST NUCLEO-G474RE on chassis bench, independent watchdog, motion interlock inputs
selection_and_verification: Dedicated to motion permissions, stops, local controls and drive feedback. Identify firmware and boot state separately from E04. Validate watchdog and fail-safe inhibit independent of Linux.

candidate_or_spec: Locking UART/USB link, level matching, short cabled SPI to gyro
selection_and_verification: Supervise command expiry and drive MCU reset. Level-shift 5 V encoder outputs as needed. Keep head data and body interconnect distinct.

candidate_or_spec: Pololu #2828, 12 V brushed 37D, 150:1 helical, quadrature encoder
selection_and_verification: Retain 12 V #2828 motors with 12.8 V nominal pack. Limit motor voltage/duty at full state of charge and test startup/stall thermal margins.

candidate_or_spec: Basicmicro RoboClaw 2×15A, IMC412
selection_and_verification: Prove safe deceleration upon inhibit, current/timeout settings and independent stop with full pack or BMS rejecting regeneration.

candidate_or_spec: Ø104 mm nominal removable treaded wheels, clamping hubs to suit 6 mm motor shaft
selection_and_verification: Bench-test traction on wood, steel, seams and any approved cold floor condition. Check frame bearing support.

candidate_or_spec: Low-profile replaceable swivel caster with sealed bearing
selection_and_verification: Select actual loaded caster height and material. Test low-temperature wheel and swivel drag, trapped grit and door-sill seams.

candidate_or_spec: Metal load frame, two gearbox mounts, grip anchors, axle supports and fasteners
selection_and_verification: Use continuous chassis load path through handle anchors. Verify balance with dummy head and production head.

candidate_or_spec: Richbeam LakiBeam 1L, 270°, Ethernet
selection_and_verification: Use for navigation. Qualify Jazzy driver, actual supply, mounting, low-temperature scan gaps and connectors. Document suitability separately for any personnel-protection function under R12.

candidate_or_spec: SICK picoScan150 PICS150-01000 Prime-1, #1134609
selection_and_verification: Alternative only. Recheck connector, supply, mounting, thermal startup, ROS 2 driver and exclusion zones if substituted.

candidate_or_spec: Power and Ethernet harness matched to the installed scanner
selection_and_verification: Provide ethernet strain relief at scanner and cold-rated cable at all moving interfaces. Record connector supply during sudden starts.

candidate_or_spec: Bosch BMI088 six-axis IMU on a carrier with SPI
selection_and_verification: Use SPI. Validate IMU axis sign, cold bias and mounting vibration under drive/turn.

candidate_or_spec: ST SATEL-VL53L4ED, two breakouts per pack
selection_and_verification: Bench-only package contains two ranging boards. One vertical and one angled test point initially.

candidate_or_spec: ST VL53L4ED, four oblique and four vertical
selection_and_verification: Target four vertical plus four oblique installed devices. Use field-intent carriers for winter trials. The evaluation boards are restricted to normal-temperature testing.

candidate_or_spec: Eight field-rated carriers or sensor PCB positions, emitter/receiver barriers, windows and short harnesses
selection_and_verification: Use scheduled addresses or mux, test timeouts and one jammed bus. Verify complete cone, returns and clocks in fitted design.

candidate_or_spec: Compliant head perimeter contact rail; reversible 3 and 5 mm alignment inserts relative to the entrance window
selection_and_verification: With 10 mm nominal entrance-window clearance, test 7 mm leading clearance for the 3 mm projection and 5 mm for the 5 mm insert. Challenge edges, small deposits and sharp splinters, guard shadow, corner rotation, stopping travel and resulting standoff.

candidate_or_spec: Compliant rear/quarter band
selection_and_verification: Validate low obstacle contact separately during straight, reverse and pivot motion.

candidate_or_spec: Omron D2HW-C201M SPDT, wired on the normally closed contact
selection_and_verification: Three forward-head and two body NC contacts. Trend wire opens/shorts and test unplugged head, switch bounce and packed ice.

candidate_or_spec: Latching mushroom, positive-opening contacts, reset and drive-inhibit circuit
selection_and_verification: Positive-opening latching E-stop interrupts motor enable independently of the Start/Resume and Pause/Stop program buttons (R06). Test braking and holding, deliberate reset and absence of automatic restart.

candidate_or_spec: Isolated RS-485 head acquisition and identification link at the proposed 1 Mbaud line rate; read uncorrected counts and live times.
selection_and_verification: Validate head identity and descriptor against the site-approved configuration; test coordinate units, version/hash, external envelope, active segments, physical offsets and supported scan modes. Unsupported or mismatched heads inhibit survey.

candidate_or_spec: Two distinct keyed locking connections for RS-485 data and protected power/interlocks per ICD.
selection_and_verification: Validate low-temperature performance, pin sequencing, mating cycles, voltage drop, independent normally closed bumper/retention chain and strain relief. The benchtop extension uses the same mating interfaces.

item: Installed removable battery pack and BMS
candidate_or_spec: 12.8 V LiFePO₄ pack, 8 Ah sizing trial, independent pack protection and compatible BMS
selection_and_verification: Select with tray R01. Check actual peak current and cold runtime, approved charger window, contact and thermal protection, weight, dimensions and positive lock. Mark pack ID. Swap with system shut down and charge plug removed.

item: Approved battery charger and matched external supply
candidate_or_spec: Pack-compatible, current-limited 4-series LiFePO₄ charge system with qualified external power input
selection_and_verification: Select charger and pack together. Establish voltage, current, cell temperatures and termination per manufacturer. Test load sharing while computer serves data, battery charge-current sensing, temperature-sensor fault behaviour and recovery.

candidate_or_spec: Dedicated ~5 V / 5 A compute rail. Fused power branches for motors, LiDAR, sensors and independently switched head and chassis heaters.
selection_and_verification: Dedicated 5 V / 5 A design allocation for the CM5 plus separate LiDAR, support sensors, motor and heater branch protection. Qualify all rail/connector limits at pack end-of-discharge and BMS disconnect.

candidate_or_spec: Reserve heater mounts, independent controls and overtemperature cutoffs for each zone. Insulate the electronics bay.
selection_and_verification: Separate head and chassis heater loops; independent cutoff each; control to measured temperatures and verify worst-case on-state currents and lag.

candidate_or_spec: Shunt or Hall-current sensor and battery-voltage input
selection_and_verification: Record pack terminal V/I plus branches during fast transients, motor lock, stop and full charge. Size shunt for pulse and logging range.

candidate_or_spec: Printed upper shell, removable lower pan, gaskets, locking hardware and service cover
selection_and_verification: Wipe-clean shell over load frame, rear battery service hatch, protected ports and head arms. Verify glove access, cold impact, handle load path, seals and independent battery retention.

candidate_or_spec: Pinned, keyed removable head with adjustable ballast and defined simulated footprint
selection_and_verification: Use matched mass/moment and a clipped-on footprint target. Verify conditional data and normal motion state with simulated head.

candidate_or_spec: Existing phone, tablet or laptop with browser; robot-hosted local Wi-Fi or site LAN plus wired service/data access
selection_and_verification: Test closed trailer coverage, local access after recovery, simultaneous viewers and one active controller. Ordinary client loss may continue an authorized unattended scan if all required supervisory channels remain healthy.

candidate_or_spec: Current-limited bench supply, stops for wheel-up tests, marked test floor and guarded edge fixture
selection_and_verification: Include restraint/fall catch independent of robot on ground-level fixture, representative surface coupons, stable references and instrumentation.

candidate_or_spec: Four side-by-side segments across one removable head. Independent optical readout per segment.
selection_and_verification: One first article with accepted assembly geometry, window and native pulse shapes; balance of three after measurement gate. Separate raw silicon readouts.

candidate_or_spec: Proposed upper reference tile per floor segment, optically isolated with independent readout.
selection_and_verification: One independently read upper reference per surveyed lane; select absorber and tile following photon-transfer and beta-leakage tests on one pair.

candidate_or_spec: Power-Sonic PSL-SC-12120; 12.8 V, 12 Ah
selection_and_verification: 15 A continuous at published conditions. Confirm motor-start-plus-heater peak, BMS charge gate, connector derating, mount and measured mass.

candidate_or_spec: Pololu D24V90F5 #2866
procurement_stage: Bench sample; exclude duplicate installed line
selection_and_verification: Supply-load test at low pack voltage and enclosure thermal limit. Check known-start policy for carrier 5 V input.

item: Primary branch protection and braking energy control
candidate_or_spec: Pack fuse, DC-rated isolation, protected branches and validated braking-energy route
selection_and_verification: Calculate wire, fuse interruption ratings, return paths and stored energy. Demonstrate fault containment, inhibit and regeneration into a fully charged or cold-inhibited pack.

item: Dedicated detachable-head acquisition MCU and descriptor memory
unit_or_scope: 1 per active head; distinct from W08
candidate_or_spec: Second ST NUCLEO-G474RE on head bench, per-head nonvolatile descriptor, independent acquisition clock and isolated data link
selection_and_verification: At initial handshake disclose head identity, geometry and limits. During acquisition report raw counts, live times, timing and health. Verify rate, reset and connection discontinuity. Add front-end hardware as needed. Conversion runs on the host. Qualify a compact cold-rated field board.

item: Programmable SiPM bias and temperature monitoring
candidate_or_spec: Matched programmable bias groups with local sensor(s), gain tracking and preamps
selection_and_verification: Separate readout per tile. Filter and shield. Check gain drift, electronic noise, dark events, cross-channel pickup and controlled shutdown.

candidate_or_spec: Analog Devices EVAL-ADM2582EEBZ, 16 Mbit/s ADM2582E
selection_and_verification: Power each end at local 3.3 V and configure half-duplex. Verify 1 Mbaud, polarity, termination at both endpoints, TX/RX turnaround, failed-link recovery, shield/return isolation and motor-on error rate.

item: Optical housings, windows, guard and interlayer coupon set
candidate_or_spec: Replaceable light-tight entrance window, guard, spacers, isolation and absorber test coupons
selection_and_verification: Record window and grille areal density, open area and shadow. Test 10 mm nominal standoff, dynamic excursions, light leaks, mechanical clearance and optical response after service and cold cycling.

candidate_or_spec: Distributed heater, temperature readback, independent thermal cutoff and switch
selection_and_verification: Reserve per head ICD; measure peak at maximum bus and average duty while measuring. Test masked heat flow, failed-open sensor, stuck heater, EMI and warm restart.

item: Chassis/battery sensors, insulation and thermal cutoff
candidate_or_spec: Cabin heater, battery temperature measurement and thermally independent cutoff
selection_and_verification: Control to local component conditions, with pack charge gating separate. Check condensation at transition and bay vent/service access.

candidate_or_spec: Externally accessible stop path selected for the placement and access-control design, distinct from web Stop and chassis E-stop
selection_and_verification: Select with site risk assessment; commission at closed doors. Supervise the path when required, force a safe hold on loss, test response and intentional reset. Confirm workers can stop hazardous motion without entering.

candidate_or_spec: Sealed, labeled multi-state indicators with color plus distinct symbols or flash patterns; optional short status display and pre-motion alert
selection_and_verification: Display ready, moving/surveying, paused, holding at a flagged spot, inhibited/fault and charging/service. Test legibility, lamp check and detector light leakage. R05 provides power/mode. R06 provides Start/Resume and a separate Pause/Stop.

candidate_or_spec: Qualified facility reference sources, holders, detector standoff gauges, timing reference and photon-field characterization instrument
selection_and_verification: Map reference-field uniformity, record source geometry/activity reference and test representative photon fields, boundaries and detector overlap.

item: Winter, electrical and mechanical test equipment
candidate_or_spec: Cold chamber or controlled exposure, temperature probes + logger, oscilloscope/current probe, ballast, force gauge and restraint
selection_and_verification: Record instrument calibration and reference uncertainty. Include low/high-light and wet floor coupons; verify system thermal margin, braking and lift mass.

candidate_or_spec: Surveyed removable fiducial targets, measured floor boundaries and mock seams/sill
selection_and_verification: Test localization references with and without removable targets. Measure dead strips and endpoint usability on representative interiors.

item: Quick-swap tray, pack coupler and latch
candidate_or_spec: Keyed, shrouded and touch-protected mating connector, positive mechanical latch with captive release, strain relief, cleanable rear access and cold-rated seals.
selection_and_verification: Use gloved, tool-free removal with the robot parked and isolated. Validate reverse/misalignment prevention, inrush/contact life and latch under shocks. Recheck center of gravity and loaded rear-caster force for every approved pack.

unit_or_scope: additional pack for the duty-cycle trial
candidate_or_spec: Same qualified pack model, mechanical key and protection as W28, with insulated transport/storage contact cover.
procurement_stage: Select with W28; spare remains off-board
selection_and_verification: Time actual pack change including safe shutdown, boot and readiness checks. Track each pack independently. Reconcile packs, chargers and charging time against duty cycle; order additional spares when justified.

item: Chassis charging inlet and hardware plug-presence interlock
candidate_or_spec: Capped, keyed low-voltage charge inlet, reverse and overcurrent protection, plug-present or equivalent mechanically linked interlock, secure cable retention.
selection_and_verification: Inserting a plug inhibits the drive-enable circuit even with a cable that carries no power. Verify unplugging during service does not re-enable motion; test cold port sealing, snag hazard and reverse feed.

item: Charge/service power path and current sensing
candidate_or_spec: Separate protected system and battery-charge paths, source budgeting and service-rail regulation for the computer and network. LTC4162-F documents one evaluation topology.
procurement_stage: Engineering selection; component is a reference
selection_and_verification: Validate adapter size with maximum service load plus selected charge current, BMS cutoff and thermal envelope. Measure net battery current. Test unplug, low/cold/full pack, telemetry loss and charger-induced resets. Keep traction hard-inhibited.

candidate_or_spec: Glove-operable master OFF / SERVICE / RUN selection or functional equivalent. Drive and service energization are independently gated. Selecting RUN alone cannot start motion. Start/Resume and Pause/Stop are separate program buttons at R06.
selection_and_verification: Test OFF-isolated traction, de-energized service procedures, charger plugged, controller restart and cable removal. Document which charging circuits can remain live in OFF and isolate before pack or connector service.

item: Physical Start/Resume and Pause/Stop program buttons
candidate_or_spec: Guarded Start/Resume and separate Pause/Stop. Make both buttons distinguishable by touch and label. The latching emergency stop W25 is independent.
selection_and_verification: Start/Resume requires authorized mission, valid mode, occupancy/access permissives, interlocks and pre-motion alert. Pressing Pause/Stop commands a controlled stop and holds position ahead of browser commands. Reset and cable removal cannot initiate motion.

candidate_or_spec: Two keyed straight-through power/interlock and isolated RS-485 extensions mating the robot and detached head; labeled LAB ONLY with strain relief.
selection_and_verification: Specify length, conductor sizes, shield, pin functions and loop resistance. Verify termination remains at true bus ends, CRC error rate at 1 Mbaud, power drop at heater load, dark noise and pull strain. Hardware immobilizes the robot throughout bench use.

item: Head bench cradle and repeatable standoff fixture
unit_or_scope: test set within W36 lab equipment
candidate_or_spec: Window-protecting cradle/positioning fixture, traceable standoff shims including 10 mm, alignment markers and reproducible source holder.
procurement_stage: Build for one full-size active pair
selection_and_verification: Calibrate with representative source geometry. Log head ID/settings, source/bkg sequence, foil/grille, live times and thermal conditions. Radiological response checks and independent bumper-contact checks have separate records.

item: Head analog front ends and acquisition hardware
candidate_or_spec: Local per-channel preamps plus shaping/discriminators or external waveform digitizer selected from full-size segment tests; quantity is one full head electronics set.
selection_and_verification: Size bandwidth, headroom, throughput and anti-alias filtering for real pulses and highest field. If onboard PSD is used, preserve raw waveform test access and measure cross-classification. E04 timing and thermal qualification are separate.

item: Spare-pack bench charging dock or adapter
candidate_or_spec: Battery-compatible bench charger or approved detachable cradle connected to an additional matched supply, enabling one pack to charge while another is in service.
procurement_stage: Optional for heavy-duty rotation; select with W28/W29
selection_and_verification: Verify pack thermal gating, current limit and battery-compatible termination. Charger capacity and rated outlet must support the planned daily rotation; use protected contacts and label the pairing.

candidate_or_spec: Independent access supervision for an unattended secured area plus the approved doorway-edge protection for elevated open-door configurations.
procurement_stage: Site safety design and pilot gate
selection_and_verification: Test entry/loss of secured access in unattended mode and the independent outside stop. Keep elevated fall protection active in every mode. Select occupied-area travel only with the R12 function qualified.

item: Shared-space personnel protection and stop interface
candidate_or_spec: Candidate low-mounted protective scanner(s) with supervised stopping outputs, or another design demonstrating equivalent risk reduction. Include the entire swept head/body.
procurement_stage: Assess existing functions, then select and cost any missing hardware
selection_and_verification: Qualify feet, cross-traffic, turns, reverse travel, occlusion, wall trapping, temperature and stop clearance. Demonstrate protective stopping independent of ROS/browser. Include actual added power, mass, thermal limits and field geometry in system budgets.
